validators.name: triage-lint
validators.title: Triage lint engine
validators.notes: Runs the lint shipped inside this pack ({pack}/lint) over the target path, so consumers can validate without any external checkout (bundle: lint/, spec/rules.json, tokens/tokens.json, rename-map.json, core/, VERSION; regenerated with the pack). --json report shape: findings[{rule,severity,file,line,message,excerpt,fix}], counts, by_rule, score.
